doc: A flow mapping takes no insert (FBL 0.10, sections 4.3 and 6.2; spec 066, edge case 15): the job mapping writes its tasks as tasks: {}, and adding a task to it is refused and writes nothing. Its body is written here.

steps.doc: The add is refused: the container is a flow mapping.
steps.refused: The tasks are written as a flow mapping, which takes no insert.
